title: Berlin Zoo Annual Pass - FAQ
subtitle: What the Zoo, Aquarium and Tierpark annual cards cost, when they pay off, and the rules at the desk.

items.q: How much is a Berlin Zoo annual pass?
items.a: **€69 for one adult for the Zoo alone,** €102.50 with the Aquarium and €119 for Zoo, Aquarium and Tierpark together. Children aged 4 to 15 pay €37, €54.50 or €63.

items.q: Is there a family annual pass for Zoo Berlin?
items.a: Yes. The **small family card** covers one parent and their own children aged 4 to 15, from €88.50 for the Zoo. The **large family card** covers both parents and their children, from €143.50.

items.q: What do I need for a family annual card?
items.a: **Everyone must live at the same postal address, each child needs proof** such as a birth certificate or a Kindergeld letter, and every family member has to be there in person when the card is issued.

items.q: After how many visits does the annual card pay off?
items.a: Against the **€25 gate price, three adult visits** already cost more than the €69 card. Against online tickets, which start at €16, it takes about five visits.

items.q: Does a Zoo card give a discount at the Tierpark?
items.a: Yes. **Zoo card holders pay half the regular day price at the Tierpark and the Aquarium,** and Tierpark card holders get the same at the Zoo and the Aquarium.

items.q: Is the subscription annual card worth it?
items.a: It saves about 10 percent, for example €62.50 instead of €69, but it **runs at least 24 months** and then needs four weeks' notice. It makes most sense in your second year.

items.q: What changes with the new Zoo annual card in November 2026?
items.a: From **2 November 2026** old Zoo and Aquarium cards can be swapped free for a new card without a printed photo. All cards must be swapped by **30 June 2027**, and swapping by 15 February 2027 brings a free Zoo day ticket.

items.q: Do I have to use face recognition with the new card?
items.a: **No, it is optional.** Without it you show the card with a photo ID as before. The Tierpark cards are not part of the change yet.

items.q: Can I bring my dog with an annual card?
items.a: **Only at the Tierpark,** where dogs on a short lead get in free. Dogs are not allowed in the Zoo or the Aquarium.
